summary: Aptevo Therapeutics filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) disclosing a press release about a clinical development milestone for mipletamig, its multispecific immuno-oncology candidate in frontline AML. The filing reports a substantial reduction in infusion-related reactions after successive refinements to the priming-dose regimen, following FDA discussions, and notes data will be presented at the ASH 68th Annual Meeting in New Orleans, December 12-15, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed. This is an ordinary product-development update, not a special situation; watch only for clinical execution and financing risk.
